_comment_default_model: Leave empty to mirror the Aside desktop app's own default model, read live from its settings.json. Set a bare model id only if you want the phone pinned to something different; model_ids below is what qualifies it with a provider.
_comment_paths: Leave these empty and both the bridge and the Mini App detect them from whichever Aside account you are signed in to (see ~/.aside/accounts.json). setup.py fills them in for you; a value you set by hand is kept as-is, including when you re-run setup.py.
_comment_model_maps: Both maps MERGE over the built-in defaults, so listing one entry overrides that entry and leaves the rest alone. model_aliases maps what you type after /model to a bare model id; model_ids qualifies that bare id with the provider that actually hosts it, which is what `aside exec -m` requires.
